The controller needs power, a reference, input definitions and appropriate
output interfaces. This drawing documents connections; it does not run
Identify the input levels, clock and reset. Plan the software or HDL
separately and check load current before connecting an output.
Document input switch, controller pins, supplies and display connections.
Firmware execution, flowchart programming and seven-segment
decoding are not ready-made TinyCAD workflows. Electrical interface
This is a connection-planning drawing. Follow each labelled net, identify
the real terminals and add your bench measurements. No simulation is
Each display segment A–G has its own 330-ohm current-limiting resistor.
COM and the unused decimal point return to the reference. OUT6 uses
GPIO1; OUT0–OUT5 use GPIO2–GPIO7. Write and test the segment
lookup table in the separate programming environment. INPUT0 has a
pull-down resistor. Connect the clock/reset labels to the development
board. Check output current and add a suitable driver for a real load.
What changed, and why? Use your readings as evidence.
Check the physical layout with your teacher before construction.
